request.prompt_preview: CASE FILE Question: Customers in Tunis and Sfax complained yesterday around lunchtime that web pages and apps would not load, even though their phones showed full signal. What was going on? Now: 2026-

response.text: The evidence shows a nationwide DNS degradation starting right around lunchtime yesterday (2026-09-02 12:00 to 14:00, ALR-0001), matching the customer complaint that web pages and apps wouldn't load. A software upgrade (CHG-2026-0001) was applied to CORE-DNS-01 at 11:00, followed by a spike in resolution latency and a drop in query success at 12:00, and a major `DNS_TIMEOUT_RATE` alarm (ALM-000003) at 12:30. Competing hypotheses are ruled out because the DNS degradation directly explains widespread app/web loading failures across Tunis and Sfax. I will conclude the investigation as the root cause is identified as the software upgrade regression on CORE-DNS-01.
